items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: No, I can't remember, Jane, of that same place.

ctx.x: You mean, like that bar we went in, you know, to get drinks the other day, was that there then?

No, I can't remember, Jane, of that same place. No, I don't believe that section was there, no, because sometimes they may put, like, little private tables on our side, you know, put like tablecloths or something on it, or a piece of white cloth in front of it. But the place would be so jam-packed during them nights, you see, on both yards would be crowded. And I would say like the other night, the fifth day when we was making a recording, the voices say you could hear when you're playing like Kelly's Love, that…
And where did he play? Inside the hall or in the yard? In the yard.
